sloka: एतत् च वन मध्यस्थम् कृष्ण अभ्र शिखर उपमम् ।पावकस्य आश्रमस्थस्य धूमाग्रम् संप्रदृश्यते ॥३-११-५१॥
transliteration: etat ca vana madhyastham kṛṣṇa abhra śikhara upamam ।pāvakasya āśramasthasya dhūmāgram saṁpradṛśyate ॥3-11-51॥

translations.english: Heaps of firewood are seen here and there on the path. There are blades of grass (used for sacrificial ceremonies) shining like vaidurya (gems).
